# xterm.js (vendored)

Unmodified files from npm, served locally so the board never loads scripts from a CDN.

| File | Package | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm` | 5.5.0 |
| `addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` | 0.10.0 |
